description:
Job Description
 Advisor will serve as a hands-on Full-Stack AI Engineer dedicated to driving the technical execution of Enterprise Gemini and high-priority artificial intelligence initiatives. Acts as the critical technical bridge between Data Science, Clinical Informatics, IT Infrastructure, and core Application Teams, accountable for taking AI use cases from concept through enterprise integration, production deployment, and ongoing support. 
 Provides strategic advice and guidance around the technical direction and engineering processes directly supporting the design, delivery and support of software applications and engineering activities within the software development function. Ensures engineering assignments, practices and implementation are aligned and in adherence with standardized and approved industry conventions and emerging directions. Identifies, evaluates, and develops processes and protocols to manage the software engineering and operational workflows with consideration to both functional and non-functional requirements. Provides expertise, guidance, and mentoring to team members. Identifies opportunities for operational improvement.
 Job Responsibility
 1.Provides strategic advice and guidance to the software development function by working with and guiding team members and building engineering consensus for applications development.
2.Advises senior leadership to define, develop, and articulate the engineering strategy for all areas of responsibility.
3.Provides technical guidance and hands-on application for all aspects of software development and delivery including software component design, development, quality assurance process, documentation, training, and application performance; determines scope, mentors and coordinates technical resources, and oversees correct and timely execution and implementation of software development projects.
4.Provide recommendations and perspectives to senior leaders, bridging gaps between high-level and code level assignments.
5.Maintains documentation of architecture, design, implementation, and rationale behind technical decisions.
6.Interfaces with other teams for development alignment and timing, works directly with product management and product owners translating business requirements to technical directions and effective use cases and establishes and administers engineering practices, policies, and processes.
7.Maitains expertise knowledge of and implements new and emerging technologies, methodologies, processes, and procedures to improve application development and support short and long-term department goals.
8.Continually identifies improvement areas for software development efficiencies.
9.Applies advanced software design methodologies in hybrid cloud and virtualized environments; serves as a consultant and advisor to software and information architects to leverage effective and common design patterns, data structures and data management.
10.Works in hybrid application environments, leading technical direction for integrations and interoperability, effective work with 3rd parties and 3rd party products as required
11.Transfers knowledge of key learnings throughout the enterprise.
12.All responsibilities noted here are considered essential functions of the job under the Americans with Disabilities Act. Duties not mentioned here, but considered related are not essential functions.
  
 Highly Preferred   
 Demonstrated hands-on experience as a Full-Stack Developer with deep proficiency in front-end/back-end engineering, API integrations (specifically LLMs and AI services), and data pipeline management. 

 Proven track record of taking software and AI use cases from concept/prototype through production deployment and enterprise integration. 

 Experience working within healthcare data environments, clinical informatics, or complex enterprise application ecosystems . 

  
 Job Qualification
 ·Bachelor's Degree required, or equivalent combination of education and related experience.
·10+ years of relevant experience and 2+ years of leadership / management experience, required.
 
 *Additional Salary Detail 
The salary range and/or hourly rate listed is a good faith determination of potential base compensation that may be offered to a successful applicant for this position at the time of this job advertisement and may be modified in the future. When determining a team member's base salary and/or rate, several factors may be considered as applicable (e.g., location, specialty, service line, years of relevant experience, education, credentials, negotiated contracts, budget and internal equity).
